proposition: GET /hosts/products/{product_id}: contract says beginning and ending are optional for the OpenShift metrics products; implementation does wrap absent dates with Optional.of in the special-product branch.

target.scenario: OpenShift metrics product with beginning or ending absent

mandatory_search.reason: §11.4.1 deterministic null crash; verify special branch and contract.

decision.rationale: Optional.of rejects missing dates before its fallback can run in the special-product branch. Optional date filters could use the existing now fallback; this deterministic null crash is an implementation fault under §9.3 R1.
decision.details: Static Optional.of(null) failure, not a runtime observation. Contract does not mark beginning/ending required and restricts applicability to OpenShift metrics products. §10.6 resource-key/mandatory persistent-field condition does not apply.
